instruction: Configure VLC to allow multiple windows to open when double-clicking media files, instead of adding them to the current playlist.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling one-instance mode in VLC by setting one-instance-when-started-from-file=0 in the VLC configuration file. The existing metric function check_one_instance_when_started_from_file validates this setting. Default value is 1 (enabled), so the agent must change it to 0 (disabled) to allow multiple VLC instances.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) from OS-specific location
Metric function correctly checks the one-instance-when-started-from-file setting in the config file
Expected value '0' is semantically correct for disabling one-instance mode (default is '1')
Postconfig correctly kills and relaunches VLC to ensure fresh state for verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires disabling one-instance mode, evaluator checks exactly that setting
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter as rules dictionary (directly accesses rule['expected_one_instance_when_started_from_file'])
Logic flow is sound: read config file -> search for setting -> compare with expected -> return 1 if match
